title: Compute Laurent expansion coefficients
action: For each test case, compute the Laurent expansion coefficients A_k and B_k (k>=1) from the dislocation position (zeta0), shape parameter m, and Burgers vector orientation. Truncate the series at a k_max sufficient for convergence (e.g., 30-50). Save the coefficients as evidence.
description: Intermediate computation of the loading coefficients A_k, B_k that feed the perturbation calculation.
output_schema: JSON containing per-case keys with m, Gamma, r0_over_R, phi0_deg, and lists A_k, B_k as complex numbers.

title: Compute perturbative potentials and image force
action: Implement the general perturbative solution for the elliptical inhomogeneity. Express the perturbative potentials as series and determine the unknown coefficients using interface continuity conditions or recurrence relations. Evaluate the image force components f_x, f_y at the dislocation position. Save the components as evidence.
description: Core elasticity computation: image force for each test case.
output_schema: JSON containing per-case keys with f_x, f_y, and convergence diagnostics.

title: Compute dimensionless glide force for all test cases
action: For each test case, project the image force onto the Burgers vector direction (B along x-axis, so Fg = f_x / |gamma| with gamma = G1*(B_y - i B_x) / [pi R (kappa1+1)]). Write one row per test case with the input parameters and the computed dimensionless glide force Fg.
description: Main scored artifact: dimensionless glide force Fg for a set of test cases covering hole, rigid inclusion, and intermediate moduli ratios, various shape parameters and dislocation positions.
output_schema: CSV header: m,Gamma,nu1,nu2,r0_over_R,phi0_deg,Fg. m: ellipticity parameter (float); Gamma: shear moduli ratio (float, 0 for hole, large e.g. 1e10 for rigid); nu1: matrix Poisson ratio (float); nu2: inclusion Poisson ratio (float); r0_over_R: dimensionless distance (float, >1); phi0_deg: angular position in degrees (float); Fg: dimensionless glide force (float).
